nim.source: vol1a-revisit/scripts/p59_nim_value.py (ARMS N-BF16, NIM_ENV) via vol2/scripts/p54_engine.py; image id from docker image inspect (versions.txt)

guardrails.environment: a new venv (gr0230srv): the P19 environment's packages at the same versions (constraints from its pip freeze) plus the server extra (aiofiles, distro, fastapi, jiter, openai, sniffio, starlette, uvicorn, watchdog); no version of a P19 package differs
guardrails.server: vol1b/scripts/p66_gr_server.py = the CLI's `server` (nemoguardrails/cli/__init__.py) with --default-config-id; host 127.0.0.1 instead of the CLI's 0.0.0.0 (cli/__init__.py:212)
guardrails.config_selection: --default-config-id (server/api.py set_default_config_id; api.py:501-507 uses it when the request names no config), so the four request bodies are identical
guardrails.usage_stats: NEMO_GUARDRAILS_NO_USAGE_STATS=1 on every server (telemetry.py:372): no usage-statistics upload; not part of the request path
guardrails.llm_framework: default (llm/frameworks/registry.py:27, NEMOGUARDRAILS_LLM_FRAMEWORK unset): the library's own OpenAI-compatible client, not LangChain

client_pool.source: nemoguardrails/llm/clients/constants.py:20 DEFAULT_CONNECTION_LIMITS, used by llm/clients/base.py:127 when no http_client is passed; read at run time by run_p66.sh (versions.txt)
client_pool.note: above every concurrency level (128), so no pool-raised variant is run

iorails_admission_queue.source: nemoguardrails/guardrails/iorails.py:80-81; enabled only when NEMO_GUARDRAILS_IORAILS_ENGINE is true/1 (nemoguardrails/__init__.py:48), which the harness removes from every server's environment

passthrough.derived: the default config's bytes up to its `# Self-check rails` comment: the same models section, no rails, no prompts

request_parameters_through_the_server: max_tokens, temperature and top_p from the request body go to the main generation call (server/api.py chat_completion -> llm_params); the self-check calls use the task's own max_tokens (library/self_check/*/actions.py). The request schema has no ignore_eos, so no arm is sent one.
parallel_rails: not applicable: one input and one output rail; not enabled
